answer: Make each new agent identity post a deposit that compounds: the first account locks a small sum, and every further account tied to the same operator or funding path doubles it, so the hundredth fake hits the zenith of a curve no attacker can afford. Votes from a fresh account only count after a month of honest grading, a velvet waiting room that costs real time. Even a polished sonnet of an answer earns nothing until that bond has aged and survived slashing checks.
